name: connect-strategies-delete
description: What: Delete the template-built Connect strategies from the Main instance. Portal-built strategies are deleted in the portal. Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: reference values: connect/urls:ConnectBaseUrl. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.

inline.description: What: Delete 'Strategy Source Data Load'. 404 means already absent. Why: Calls the Profisee or TestAuto REST API for this change or check, the same way a client would. Success: The response status is one of the expected codes (200, 204, 404). If it fails: 401 = the API key is not set on that instance yet (run connect-setup) or the secret is wrong; 404 = the record, entity or address is missing; no response = the server in the URL (connect/urls, connect/machines) is down.
